films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries keeps the palace bard among Odysseus' household — Phemius as the singer spared when the suitors fall.

films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's Italian-Yugoslav Odyssey stages the Ithacan court where Phemius sings the returns from Troy against Penelope's grief.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's self-taught bard of Odysseus' house — forced to sing for the suitors, spared at Telemachus' word, then ordered to play wedding songs loud enough to mask the slaughter.

popCulture.title: Phemius
popCulture.description: Son of Terpes, minstrel of Ithaca — the Odyssey's figure of the poet who sings unwillingly and lives.
